fire.name: Fire
fire.identity: Direct heat → burn → a fire trail behind burning enemies.

fire_trail.name: Fire Trail
fire_trail.desc: Burning enemies leave a trail lasting {trail_dur} s; enemies in it take {trail_dps} fire damage/s.

ice.name: Ice
ice.identity: Ice hit → slow → freeze → shards on frozen death → frost nova.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.desc: Every hit adds 1 cold; at {cold_threshold} cold it freezes for {freeze} s.

ice_shards.name: Ice Shards
ice_shards.desc: Enemies killed while frozen split into {shards} shards, dealing {shard_dmg} ice damage to nearby enemies.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.desc: When an enemy freezes, enemies within {nova_r} tiles also freeze for half the duration.

chain.name: Bounce
chain.desc: Bounces to {chain} nearby targets (power ×{chain_power} per bounce).

overload.name: Overload
overload.desc: Each electric hit adds 1 charge; at {charge_max} charges: +{discharge} electric damage and {shock} s shock.

poison.name: Poison
poison.identity: Poison damage over time → stacks → healing suppression → spread on death. No explosions or ground fields (v4).

toxic_stack.name: Toxic Stacks
toxic_stack.desc: Poison stacks up to {max_stacks} times (+50% per stack).

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.desc: On poisoned death, {contagion_pct}% of stacks spread to the nearest enemy (no explosion).

wet.name: Soak
wet.desc: Wets for {wet_dur} s (wet: ×1.5 electric damage, freezes sooner, shorter burns).

push.name: Push
push.desc: Pushes the target back {push} tiles along the path (×1.5 against burning targets).

wave.name: Wave
wave.desc: Water hits become waves: 25% damage, wet and push within {wave_r} tiles.

stone.name: Stone
stone.identity: Heavy hit → armor shred → fragments → concussion.

fragments.name: Stone Fragments
fragments.desc: On impact, {frags} fragments carry 50% of the hit to nearby enemies.

concussion.name: Concussion
concussion.desc: Hits stun for {stun} s (once per target every 2 s).

dazzle.name: Dazzle
dazzle.desc: Blinds for {blind_dur} s: enemy attack accuracy drops by 30%.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: Hits illuminate for 3 s: targets take +{lit_pct}% damage from all towers.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Bleeding enemies take {per_tile} damage per tile moved for {dur} s. Pushes count too.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.desc: Repeated hits increase intensity (up to {max_int}, +25% per level).

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.desc: At maximum intensity: {rupture} blood damage, then intensity resets.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.identity: Falling meteor → area impact → fragments → meteor shower.

meteor_strike.name: Meteor Strike
meteor_strike.desc: A meteor falls on the target every {period} s: {hit} impact damage.

meteor_fragments.name: Impact Fragments
meteor_fragments.desc: {frags} fragments carry 50% damage to nearby enemies.

meteor_shower.name: Meteor Shower
meteor_shower.desc: {minis} small meteors land around the main impact (40%).

volcano.name: Volcano
volcano.identity: Summons a roadside volcano that spits lava blobs → splash → wide eruption → lava pool.

lava_blob.name: Lava Blob
lava_blob.desc: Summons a volcano for {life} s; every {period} s it spits a lava blob within 1.5 tiles: {lava} lava damage.

splash.name: Lava Splash
splash.desc: Blobs splash within {splash_r} tiles on impact (60%).

wide_eruption.name: Wide Eruption
wide_eruption.desc: Each eruption sends {blobs} blobs at different targets.

lava_pool.name: Lava Pool
lava_pool.desc: Blobs leave a lava pool lasting {pool_dur} s: {pool_dps}/s.

golem.name: Golem
golem.identity: Walking ally → stone skin → ground slam.

golem_punch.name: Golem Punch
golem_punch.desc: Summons a golem for {life} s; it walks to the nearest enemy and deals {punch} physical damage every second.

ground_slam.name: Ground Slam
ground_slam.desc: Every {slam_every} hits, slams the ground within {slam_r} tiles.

hive.name: Hive
hive.identity: Hive and beetles → brood → swarm focus.

beetle_bite.name: Beetle Bite
beetle_bite.desc: Creates a hive for {life} s; up to {beetles} beetles, {bite} damage per bite.

brood.name: Brood
brood.desc: Beetles that kill spawn another beetle (up to +2).

swarm_focus.name: Swarm Focus
swarm_focus.desc: Beetles attack a single marked target together.

mana.name: Mana
mana.identity: Economy rune: converts its damage into mana → converts all damage around a marked enemy into mana → drops crystals (mana stones) on marked death.

mana_siphon.name: Mana Siphon
mana_siphon.desc: {hit} mana damage; {siphon_pct}% of damage in this event becomes mana. When grafted, also converts the base rune's damage on that ability.

mana_mark.name: Mana Mark
mana_mark.desc: Hits mark for {mark_dur} s: {mark_pct_pct}% of all damage from any tower in a {mark_r}-tile radius becomes mana.

crystallize.name: Crystallize
crystallize.desc: Marked enemies drop +{crystal} mana stones on death.

carriers.impact_area: on each target in the area

never_exported.SummonVolcano: Summons cannot be grafted; a volcano is summoned only when Volcano is the base rune (v4 §17.2).
never_exported.MeteorCall: Meteor calls cannot be grafted; only impact damage is carried.

verbs.carrier.field: field effect jumps to a neighbor
verbs.carrier.death: death effect transfers to a neighbor
verbs.ability.golem.golem_punch: punch shockwave transfers to a neighbor

templates.op_nova: , on freeze: also freezes enemies within {radius} tiles
templates.op_charge: at {max} charges: +{burst} electric damage, {stun} s shock
templates.op_mana_mark: mana mark for {dur} s: {pct}% of damage in a {radius}-tile radius becomes mana
templates.op_siphon: {pct}% of damage in this event becomes mana
templates.cost_note: Runes are bought and combined with mana; towers are built with mana stones.
